overall_goal: Prepare the workspace, retrieve ingredients, and weigh spices for cooking

goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap, washes their hands with soap, and dries them with a kitchen towel.

goals.description: Retrieve chopping board and open cabinets
goals.rationale: The person opens drawers and cabinets to take out a plastic chopping board and adjusts it on the counter.

goals.description: Retrieve ingredients and tools from fridge and cabinets
goals.rationale: The person gathers various items including ghee, pepper, a weighing scale, garlic, onion, chilli, and chopped vegetables from the refrigerator and cabinets.

goals.description: Store unused vegetables in the fridge
goals.rationale: The person seals a plastic container box of chopped vegetables and places it back into the refrigerator.

goals.description: Review recipe and set up weighing scale
goals.rationale: The person checks the recipe notebook for required ingredients and then retrieves a small plate to place on the weighing scale.

goals.description: Open spice container and set up plates
goals.rationale: The person opens a plastic box containing spices, places its lid aside, and retrieves another small plate from the cabinet to set on the hob.
The person closes and seals several plastic bags containing bay leaves, cinnamon sticks, and cloves using rubber bands and by pressing them shut.

goals.description: Weigh cashew nuts and record weight
goals.rationale: The person places cashew nuts on the weighing scale and uses a pen to write down their measured weight in the notebook.

goals.description: Transfer cashews to spice plate and seal bag
goals.rationale: The person seals the bag of cashews and moves the weighed cashew nuts from the scale to the plate containing other spices.

goals.description: Pack spice bags into container and store it
goals.rationale: The person compresses multiple bags of spices into the black container box, seals it with its lid, and places it back into the cabinet.

goals.description: Retrieve a spoon for measuring spices
goals.rationale: The person opens the cutlery drawer to look for spoons, puts them back, and instead picks up a tablespoon from the chopping board.
The person handles bags of garam masala and fennel seeds, making space on the spice plate and undoing the rubber band to open the fennel seeds.
